'''Du Mai''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Du Mai system/Legends|Du Mai system]], a part of the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It featured a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[Cave/Legends|cave]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

At some point by [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]], a holy [[Gender/Legends|man]] known as the [[Lost Prophet]] resided in the cave and attracted pilgrims by giving them pieces of gnomic advice. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Cindel Towani]] revealed that the utterances made by the Lost Prophet consisted of scrambled bits of conditioning and [[Flash training|flash-training]] that [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had undergone on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] planet that was the origin point of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] that had served the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Furthermore, Towani gave compelling evidence that the holy man had been a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who had crashed his [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> on Du Mai during the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of that conflict, in the process sustaining head injuries.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Du Mai was originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. The section featuring the world was cut before the book's release; however, it was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Du Mai [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Du Mai itself, in grid square R-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
